title: Does MasTec's 42% EPS Outlook Highlight Its 2026 Growth Story?
author: Na
description: MasTec (MTZ) delivered robust Q2 2026 results with 23.4% revenue growth and 48.8% EPS surge to $2.22, supported by a record $21.4 billion backlog up 30% year-over-year. The company raised full-year EPS guidance to $9.30 (42% growth) and completed the Superior Group acquisition, adding 3,000 employees and strengthening data-center capabilities. However, the stock has declined 35.2% over six months and trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 18.28.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Strong Q2 financial performance with 23.4% revenue growth, 48.8% EPS surge, record $21.4B backlog (+30% YoY), upgraded 2026 EPS guidance to $9.30 (+42%), and strategic Superior Group acquisition strengthening market position in high-growth data-center and clean energy sectors.

Benefits from robust AI infrastructure and data-center demand with $15.62 billion in remaining performance obligations, demonstrating strong market tailwinds in the infrastructure construction sector.
Well-positioned to benefit from grid modernization and power demand from data centers with disciplined capital deployment strategy, operating in favorable demand backdrop alongside peers.

title: Quanta Targets Up to $2.5B FCF: Can Cash Momentum Stay Strong?
author: Na
description: Quanta Services (PWR) raised its 2026 free cash flow guidance to $2-$2.5 billion following strong first-half results, driven by a record $53.4 billion backlog and favorable working-capital trends. The company generated $1.07 billion in first-half FCF, significantly higher than the prior year. However, cash flow could fluctuate due to project timing, working capital needs, and capital expenditures. PWR stock has gained 58.1% over the past year and currently trades at a premium valuation with a forward P/E of 36.07.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Raised full-year 2026 FCF guidance to $2-$2.5 billion, achieved record $53.4 billion backlog, generated strong first-half FCF of $1.07 billion (up from $288 million in 2025), and improved working capital metrics. Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating supports positive outlook.

Has healthy record $21.4 billion backlog and expects over $1 billion operating cash flow in 2026, but generated negative $59 million free cash flow in Q2, indicating greater working-capital and investment requirements compared to Quanta.

Benefits from strong demand in electrical and mechanical construction with record $17.14 billion RPOs, demonstrating solid revenue visibility and strong cash-flow conversion, but no specific performance metrics provided for direct comparison.
